## 🫐 Blueberry Scones Recipe

### Ingredients:
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 tablespoon baking powder
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 1/2 cup blueberries
- 1/4 cup butter, softened
- 1 large egg
- 1/4 cup milk

1. Preheat oven to **375°F (190°C)**.
